name: @pipeworx/mcp-licenses

tools.name: lookup_license
tools.description: Look up an open-source license by its exact SPDX id (e.g. "MIT", "Apache-2.0", "GPL-3.0-only", "BSD-3-Clause"). Returns the full name, OSI/FSF approval, deprecation status, and reference URLs. Keyless.

tools.name: search_licenses
tools.description: Search the SPDX license list by keyword (matches the id or name), e.g. "GPL", "creative commons", "mozilla". Keyless.

tools.name: get_license_text
tools.description: Fetch the full license text for an SPDX id (e.g. "MIT"). Keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-licenses forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the licenses pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
